page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8i.48xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal server instance configured for enterprise workloads requiring extensive compute and memory footprints. The system is driven by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a nominal clock speed of 2.7 GHz, delivering 192 dedicated physical and virtual execution threads. System memory totals 1024.0 GB of RAM, which yields approximately 5.33 GB of memory per core. The server operates under a KVM hypervisor architecture without GPU accelerators.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth capacity, facilitating high-throughput node interconnectivity and cloud storage communication. The configuration does not include local storage disks, requiring all persistent file systems and block storage to attach over the network infrastructure. The absence of local disk drives shifts primary data persistence architectures toward network-attached storage tiers, while the 100 Gbps baseline interface ensures high transfer rates.

From an operational resource perspective, the instance consolidates substantial parallel processing capacity and large memory on a single bare metal host. This design eliminates virtualization overhead and noisy-neighbor contention. The resource configuration suits enterprise database clusters, extensive in-memory processing, enterprise-scale backend applications, virtualization hosting, and massive continuous integration pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8i.48xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal server instance built on the x86_64 architecture for enterprise computing environments. Powered by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at 2.7 GHz, the platform provides 192 dedicated vCPUs paired with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 5.33 GB of RAM per execution thread. The instance incorporates a high-speed network interface featuring a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth, optimizing cluster communication and remote volume transfers. There is no bundled local storage, meaning primary file storage must rely completely on external network-attached storage solutions. Additionally, no GPU acceleration hardware is included. Operating as a bare metal system managed via KVM, the configuration eliminates virtualization overhead and guarantees dedicated resource access. This setup is appropriate for memory-heavy enterprise databases, large-scale container platforms, batch processing, and high-concurrency enterprise services.
